description: This file defines and exports a Vitest configuration function tailored for processing test files related to the 'process' component. It imports a scoped Vitest configuration builder and creates a specific configuration for tests matching the pattern 'src/process/**/*.test.ts'. The default export is the result of invoking this configuration function.

methods.name: export function createProcessVitestConfig(env?: Record<string, string | undefined>) { createProcessVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vitest configuration object tailored for processing test files in the 'src/process' directory with customizable environment variables.
